decisions.expectationScope: individual intraspecific variation plus nonpurposeful cross-generation variation, no genetics/meiosis/selection
decisions.coverage: two required coherent aspects; both cases require a positive description and an explanation, not only rejection of an error

suppliedHelp: One species is given, so no species-identification evidence is credited.
Parent medium pods and offspring unequal pod lengths/seed counts are facts, not produced evidence.
Same growth conditions do not establish exclusively genetic causes.
uncuedPerformance: Explain variation in the new generation without a purpose or invented genetics.
Evaluate the goal-directed claim with evidence.
cases.finding: Unequal offspring pod lengths are compatible with every offspring pod being longer than the medium parent pods. Expected use of not-all-lengthened pods is not established.
cases.minimalCorrectionDe: Ihre Nachkommen haben kürzere, mittellange und längere Hülsen sowie unterschiedlich viele Samen.
cases.minimalCorrectionEn: Their offspring have shorter, medium-length and longer pods as well as different seed counts.
cases.correctnessBoundary: Reject purposeful causal claim as unsupported; do not infer exclusively genetic causes from equal conditions.

suppliedHelp: Single-species status and shell forms are supplied.
The timeline explicitly supplies pre-substrate-change occurrence.
uncuedPerformance: Describe individual and generational variation in a new animal case.
Explain why previously present forms do not require planned development to fit a later substrate.
cases.reason: Chronology supports the limited nonpurposeful conclusion; no genotype/inheritance law or selection mechanism is demanded.

decisions.essentialUnderstandingContent: sound; gene, product and phenotype distinguished; no universal one-gene-one-trait or solely genetic determination

suppliedHelp: E function enables pigment; observed violet/colourless outcomes are given.
Model labels do not count as recalled definitions.
uncuedPerformance: Build and label a coherent relation distinguishing gene/product/trait.
Explain observed outcomes using the given function, rather than only repeating labels.
Limit real-world inference from a simplified one-pathway model.
cases.reason: Correct conditional model; adequate positive representation/explanation even though the input functional facts are supplied.

suppliedHelp: R equality, P functional tests and precursor availability are supplied.
All three visible outcomes are given.
uncuedPerformance: Explain why B and C share a phenotype despite different missing necessary components.
Connect R to P-mediated function and precursor dependence.
Explain why identical gene instructions alone do not determine the trait.
cases.reason: Fresh model disturbance and necessary-condition transfer; no invented mutation, regulation or molecular sequence requirement.

decisions.expectationScope: nonmolecular new hereditary variants, recombination and selection on existing inherited variation
decisions.essentialUnderstandingContent: sound; recombination changes combinations, not necessarily alleles; selection changes spread through differential reproductive success, not purposeful creation

suppliedHelp: The case stipulates existing combinations, actual new hereditary variant event and inheritance.
Relative offspring contributions 4 versus1 are given.
No reproductive advantage of orange is given.
uncuedPerformance: Distinguish new hereditary variant origin from reshuffling existing variants.
Explain possible generational spread through differential reproductive success.
Keep mutation benefit open and avoid need-directed creation.
cases.reason: Mutation inference is limited to the explicitly documented genuinely new hereditary event in the supplied model, never to a merely newly observed phenotype in an uncontrolled real population. For final wording, specifying a newly altered inherited factor would further avoid phenotype/genotype ambiguity without asking for molecular detail.

suppliedHelp: Crossing only existing variants and absence of new variant are stipulated.
Dry/wet viable-seed contributions 6:2 and2:6 and heritability are supplied.
A new heritable flower variant is stipulated; its fitness is unmeasured.
uncuedPerformance: Distinguish combination origin from environmental spread.
Explain reversed selective trends in dry versus wet contexts.
State why the new variant advantage remains unknown.
cases.reason: Correct possible—not certain quantitative—population trends. Fresh environmental reversal tests transfer without molecular mechanisms or a selection-mode quota.
